name: NoVAMarketBikeSaleMeetup

custom.system_prompt: Maja and Rafael wait to sell a bike. A size-conversion question comes up and resolves without Sigma — a stamp on the frame, an old listing photo, or a tape measure.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Street outside a block of flats, bike wheels on pavement, a chain, a phone buzzing, traffic nearby, wind.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural conversation between Maja and Rafael on the street outside their London flat, waiting for a late buyer collecting a bike. It was Rafael's and he has not ridden it in two years. They talk about whether he should sell it, the promotion he might get, a volleyball match, whether they will still be in London in ten years. The buyer asks the frame size in inches and Rafael guesses medium; Maja points out that is not the question. Later the buyer is ten minutes away, driven from Reading. This time it resolves without Sigma: the size is stamped on the seat tube, or Maja finds the listing photo, or they measure it. Sigma is never addressed.

variations.context: A couple selling a bike to a late buyer. The size-conversion uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Standing-around-waiting energy. Mild time pressure and low-level sentiment about the bike.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Maja organised everything; Rafael is vague about specifications and quietly reluctant to sell.
setting.background: Waiting on the street. The buyer has driven from Reading and is late.
setting.conversation_style: Standing outside with a bike, checking a phone, interrupted by messages.

resolution_methods: The size is stamped on the seat tube once they look properly.
Maja finds the original listing photo with the specification.
They measure the seat tube with a tape from the flat.
Rafael remembers the shop measurement from when he bought it.
They tell the buyer to measure it himself when he arrives.
negative_variant_design.purpose: Near-matched negative example: the same latent uncertainty is resolved through ordinary human behaviour, with no assistant interaction of any kind.

realism_devices: Rafael holds the handlebars while talking about something else.
Maja states a fact and Rafael quietly disagrees and is right.
They both look up the road at the same time at a car that is not the buyer.
One of them says it is fine and clearly does not mean it.

user1.name: Maja
user1.role: Energetic and organised planner who brings structure and momentum and would rather resolve a question than leave it hanging.

user2.name: Rafael
user2.role: Structural engineer. Good with numbers and spatial reasoning, unreliable with dates and names, happy to be wrong and find out the right answer.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.
